important_notice: The 59 records hold real local music: 55 are byte-identical copies of local pool recordings and 4 are locally cut, re-encoded excerpts of the byte-duplicate recordings on disk. source_url holds a candidate Pixabay Music track page URL that has NOT been opened or verified by a human. Treat it as unverified. checksum and duration_seconds are measured from the local files listed in data/audio-library.json. Never treat any of this as licensed audio or a Content ID clearance.

track_schema.source_url: string|null; verified individual Pixabay track page URL only

track_schema.approved_for_production: boolean; false must remain the safe default until review
track_schema.source_url_status: candidate_unverified|candidate_verified|not_applicable; the status of the source_url field
track_schema.source_search_url: string; working Pixabay Music search URL a reviewer can use to find the real track
